item.title: [DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Mon 19:17): Studentenproteste | Video-Überwachung | Stadt in Angst
item.description:
Originally published Mon 26 Oct 2026 19:17 IST.
In ganz Europa protestieren junge Menschen für eine bessere Zukunft. Auch in Deutschland sollen am Samstag bundesweit Demos stattfinden. Was halten Studierende in Berlin davon? Weitere Themen: Pläne für Videoüberwachung in Brandenburg, Tatverdächtiger nach Bluttat in Ortrand aus U-Haft entlassen. Und: Deutsch-polnische Gesundheitskooperation vor dem Aus?   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Tue 07:28): Israel holds first election since October 7th attacks
item.description:
Originally published Tue 27 Oct 2026 07:28 IST.

Israel is holding its first general election since the October 7th Hamas attacks in 2023, with Benjamin Netanyahu seeking to maintain his hold on power after three years of war. Also: after his shock defeat in the Brazilian election, the right wing opposition candidate, Flávio Bolsonaro, says he's now been banned from leaving the country. Anthropic files for a potentially record-breaking stock market valuation. Two Catholic bishops in the US say they regret meeting President Trump, after images of them praying with him are released by a White House aide. Harry Kane becomes the first English footballer in 25 years to win the game's most prestigious individual award - the Ballon d'Or. A convicted murderer in Australia loses his legal challenge against the ban on Vegemite in prisons. 'Maxxing' is selected as Dictionary.com's word of the year.
